categories.parameter: analysis settings (seeds, permutations, thresholds, CI level, chance)
categories.threshold: conventional significance levels next to p/q/FDR/alpha
categories.task_given: literal appears in the task text (excluded)

method.sources: complete stdout and every text file written by the code (persisted per execution unit via code_execution_persist_dir; fallback: the capped report in CODE_EXECUTION.json) of the same iteration (current) or of earlier executor iterations of the run (earlier); stderr and code are not sources
method.match: equal after rounding to the shown precision (tolerance half a unit in the last shown digit); percent <-> fraction; sign-agnostic fallback flagged
method.plan_only: no execution: every result number is untraceable by definition

channels.agent_text: numbers the agent typed in its response outside code blocks; traced against the executed outputs
channels.generated_reports: numbers in *.md reports written by the executed code; computed unless the executed code contains the literal; a literal that matches no stdout / non-narrative output value is hard_coded (untraceable)

iterations.note: plan-only control: nothing was executed, so every reported result number is untraceable by definition
